Name: Craftable EXP Books
Author: gsrsesgs
Description: small mod to add crafting recipes for the EXP books of all 5 skills. Config lets you choose what level the books unlock at, but the fishing book has an ingredient you don't unlock until level 6. and if you wanna suggest some balance changes, feel free.
